title: Administrator
description:
Adminstrator

Luton

13.45 per hour

Temporary to Permanent Opportunity

Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm

In the office everyday.

We are currently recruiting for an Order Processor to join a well-established and growing business based in Bedfordshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with administration, customer service or order processing experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering a high level of accuracy.

This role is initially offered on a temporary basis with the genuine opportunity to become permanent for the right person.

The Role

As part of a busy and supportive team, you will play a key role in ensuring customer orders are processed accurately and efficiently from start to finish.

Responsibilities will include:
- Processing customer orders and purchase orders
- Managing product codes, pricing information and delivery details
- Handling customer queries and order amendments
- Liaising with internal departments including Sales, Purchasing and Warehouse teams
- Monitoring shared inboxes and responding to customer requests
- Updating internal systems and maintaining accurate records
- Managing urgent orders and prioritising workloads effectively
- Supporting customers to ensure orders are fulfilled on time

No two days are the same, making this an ideal role for someone who enjoys variety and thrives in a busy office environment.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to speak with candidates who have experience within:
- Order Processing
- Sales Administration
- Customer Service Administration
- Logistics Administration
- Commercial Office Support

To be successful, you'll need:
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational skills
- The ability to manage multiple priorities
- A proactive and positive attitude
- Confidence communicating with customers and colleagues
- Good knowledge of Microsoft Outlook and office systems
- The ability to learn new processes quickly

What's In It For You?
- Temporary to permanent opportunity
- Supportive and friendly team environment
- Structured training and onboarding
- Buddy system and shadowing programme
- Modern office environment
- Monday to Friday working hours
- Opportunity to develop within a growing business

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone looking to join a company where they will be supported from day one and become a valued member of the team.

To apply, please submit your CV today. Interviews are available immediately.

title: Assistant Logistics Coordinator
description:
A leading aerospace manufacturer are looking for a proactive Assistant Logistics Coordinator to join a growing Supply Chain team and play a vital role in managing import, export, customs and freight operations.
- Role: Assistant Logistics Coordinator
- Duration: Initial 6-month contract
- Pay: 14 - 16 p/hr (Inside IR35)
- Location: Bedfordshire (Fully onsite)

As a key member of the Supply Chain team, you'll support the day-to-day management of imports, exports and customs activities.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinating customs clearances and international shipments.
- Reviewing and validating customs declarations and shipping documentation.
- Liaising with freight forwarders, customs brokers and suppliers to resolve shipment queries.
- Managing import and export records, ensuring complete audit trails and compliance documentation.
- Supporting Temporary Admission and Inward Processing customs authorisations.
- Assisting with CBAM reporting requirements and trade compliance activities.
- Providing support and guidance on HS Codes, Commodity Codes and CPC Codes.
- Preparing export invoices and shipping documentation using SAP.
- Working closely with internal departments to obtain customs, product and country-of-origin information.

You'll work with international suppliers, freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure goods move efficiently, compliantly and on time.

Key Requirements:
- Aerospace, manufacturing, engineering or similar environment experience
- Experience in logistics, exports, customs, shipping, international trade or freight forwarding.
- Strong understanding of import/export processes and customs procedures.
- Knowledge of commodity codes, customs documentation and UK customs legislation.
- Experience liaising with customs brokers, freight providers and external stakeholders.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- SAP experience

This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy and collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

If you're local to Bedfordshire, looking for a new role to develop your logistics and customs expertise within a dynamic business and happy to be fully onsite, apply now!

title: Customer Service
description:
Customer Service Advisor- Temporary to Permanent

Location: Bedford

13.000phr

Mon- Friday 40 hour week

Temp to perm

Our Client is looking for an experienced customer Service Advisor to join their growing team. If you're passionate about delivering exceptional customer service, enjoy building strong customer relationships, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

The Role

As a Customer Service Advisor, you'll be the first point of contact for many of our customers, providing a friendly, professional, and efficient service across a broad range of products. You'll process customer orders, manage enquiries, resolve issues, and work closely with colleagues across the business to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

This is a varied role that combines customer service, sales support, administration, and operational collaboration, making it ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership and making a real difference.

What You'll Be Doing
- Deliver outstanding customer service across phone, email, and other communication channels.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently, ensuring prompt fulfilment.
- Handle customer enquiries and provide product guidance and recommendations.
- Escalate technical product enquiries to specialist teams where appropriate.
- Resolve customer issues and complaints professionally, achieving positive outcomes.
- Liaise with internal departments and external stakeholders to ensure smooth order processing.
- Follow up quotations and proactively engage with customers.
- Identify and communicate sales opportunities to the External Sales Team.
- Support branch operations, including warehouse or trade counter activities when required.
- Participate in stock cycle counting.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.
- Support the wider branch team and undertake additional duties as required.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who enjoys helping customers, takes pride in delivering excellent service, and works well as part of a team.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in a customer service, sales support, or internal sales role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with great attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
- A proactive approach to problem solving and customer service.
- Experience using ERP or order processing systems (desirable).
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office.
- A willingness to develop product knowledge and learn about our industry.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive (Manufacturing)

Bedford

40,000 per annum + (Depending on industry exp.) + Bonus

Permanent position

Are you an experienced and motivated B2 B Sales Executive, looking for a new role challenge in the manufacturing sector? If so, we currently have a permanent position available for a well-respected and successful company in Bedford.

This role involves growing existing accounts and developing new business, with an emphasis on proactively identifying sales opportunities. We are looking for a candidate who has experience of business to business (B2 B) sales in a manufacturing environment and a drive to engage with prospective customers.

Responsibilities required include:
- Proactively participate in outbound sales activity, including targeted cold calls and customer visits
- Identify opportunities to generate new business and put strategies in place to achieve success
- Manage a portfolio of key customer accounts, maintaining strong relationships and regular contact
- Achieve set gross profit targets for managed accounts, new business and other business
- Deal with incoming enquiries and third-party stock sourcing where necessary
- Provide regular feedback on sales performance and market/customer trends
- Working mainly office-based but sometimes visiting key customers or important prospects, when required
- Ensure in-depth knowledge of our entire product range and competition
- Develop a thorough understanding of customer requirements on a business and technical level

Experience required for the Sales Executive include:
- Previous experience of B2 B sales within the manufacturing, engineering or material stock-holding sector/s
- Ability to learn technical product details quickly and effectively
- Demonstrate evidence of previous key account management
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- The ability to think strategically and proactively identify new opportunities

- Clear alignment with our company values of responsiveness, reliability and respect

If this opportunity is of interest to you, please apply with your up to date CV today!
